items.title: Nascent Re issues $36m across Plymouth / Warwick preferred share insurance-linked securities
items.summary: This content is copyright to www.artemis.bm and should not appear anywhere else, or an infringement has occurred. Nascent Re Ltd. a licensed reinsurance transformer owned and operated by Bermuda-based Nascent Group, has issued another $36 million of preferred share insurance-linked securities, across two series named Plymouth and Warwick.
